intro: The Philidor is the soundest way to meet 1.e4. Black does not try to attack at all — it builds the solid d6/e5 wall, keeps every piece off the back rank, and repeats position until White runs out of patience. The wins come from White grabbing a pawn in a blocked position and then finding that simplifying is not available. It is the safest opening in the book and the easiest to learn.
